From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@medixa.com>

Date: 2026-11-15 08:12 +01:00
Subject: DPA redlines and SCCs — urgent regulator ask

Hi David / Ben,

Attached is our redline to Redwood's DPA (v3). Regulator in Germany has asked us to confirm that cross-border pathways are explicit and that customer data keys are under customer's control where available. Our procurement team is pushing for signatures on the MSA + Order Form next week, but legal needs a clean DPA before they will sign.

High level asks from Medixa:
- Insert a Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) reference and require TIA completion before any cross-border move.
- Option for customer-managed keys (BYOK) or HSM attestation for any EU health data.
- Clear subprocessors list + hosting region clause in an exhibit (they want Germany/EU first).

See attached redline (Medixa_DPA_redline_v3.docx). Procurement will expect a response with either agreed redline or a counter-proposal by 2026-11-22.

Anna Keller
Senior Counsel — Medixa Health
anna.keller@medixa.com

I put a quick internal note attached summarizing the ask. Procurement timeline is tight so let's aim to reply with a proposed DPA v4 and a TIA checklist by end of day 16th if possible.

Thanks —

Date: 2026-11-15 14:20 +01:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and SCCs — urgent regulator ask

David / Laura — quick read-through notes (high level):

1) SCCs / TIA: Medixa is asking for a Transfer Impact Addendum callout and completion gate. We should accept the concept but limit the scope: require the TIA for any change to cross-border routing (i.e., new regions or subprocessors) rather than every routine ops change. Proposed wording in attached snippets.

2) BYOK / KMS: engineering note — Dedicated and Private can support BYOK (customer-provided keys via KMS/HSM) with some configuration effort. Hosted API (multi-tenant) cannot support full BYOK today without significant architectural changes. Operational compromise: offer BYOK for Dedicated/Private and for Hosted provide 'customer-managed encryption at rest' via a managed key envelope (not full BYOK) + certificate of attestation. Also propose a 30-day implementation window after contract signature, with explicit acceptance criteria.

3) Exhibit for hosting regions / subprocessors: agree to include an Exhibit listing current subprocessors and EU hosting regions; add a 60‑day notice for adding new subprocessors.

4) Telemetry/metrics carveout: we can agree to an anonymized telemetry exception (operational metrics only) — propose explicit language to prevent product telemetry being considered personal data.

5) Timeline: procurement wants signed docs by 2026-11-22. If Legal (Laura) signs off on the draft counters today/tomorrow we can route back to Medixa.

I'll attach proposed clause snippets to incorporate into v4.

Ben Carter
Contracts Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_clause_snippets.txt

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@medixa.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16 09:40 +01:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and SCCs — jurisdiction fit, KMS options and redline coordination

Anna — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. I reviewed Medixa's v3 and Ben's notes; attached is a proposed DPA v4 with our counter-redlines (DPA_v4_redline.docx) and a TIA checklist (TIA-checklist.xlsx) that narrows the TIA gate to material cross-border moves or addition of jurisdictions/subprocessors.

Summary of key compromises we propose:
- Transfer Impact Addendum (Exhibit C): include a short TIA template and require completion before any new cross-border processing is enabled. For legacy routing described in the Order Form, the TIA will document mitigations instead of blocking go‑live.
- KMS / BYOK: Offer BYOK for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted, offer managed envelope keys with documented attestation plus a 30‑day implementation SLA for customers who convert to Dedicated/Private after signature. Language: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to support customer-managed keys on Dedicated and Private deployments within thirty (30) days of Customer's request; for Hosted deployments, Redwood will provide key‑management attestation and a documented migration path."
- Subprocessors / Hosting Regions: include Exhibit listing current subprocessors and EU regions; 60‑day notice for additions with right to object for material changes.
- Telemetry carveout: explicit clause that aggregated/anonymous operational telemetry is excluded from Customer Personal Data.

Open asks for Medixa to confirm:
- Will a 30‑day SLA for BYOK on Dedicated/Private be acceptable?
- Is Medixa willing to accept attestation + migration path for Hosted as a temporary measure?

We can incorporate any final language changes and then Ben can finalize the DPA to send back to Anna for signature.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
Attachments: DPA_v4_redline.docx; TIA-checklist.xlsx

Laura / David / Ben — thank you for the quick turnaround and the clear counter. The summary looks reasonable and addresses the regulator's main concerns. A few follow-ups from our side before we route to procurement:

1) BYOK timeline: Procurement asked whether the 30‑day SLA is guaranteed and whether an implementation plan will be included in the Order Form. Can Redwood include a short schedule template in the Order Form so procurement can validate the integration effort?

2) Evidence: we will need SOC 2 Type II and a KMS attestation (HSM model / key separation description) as proof. Can Redwood provide links to current reports or agree to provide the attestation during the onboarding window?

3) TIA scope: Medixa legal is OK with the TIA being limited to material cross-border moves, but asks that the TIA be completed and accepted by Medixa before any routing change for production data.

If Redwood can confirm the BYOK schedule template and provide SOC 2 + attestation, Procurement is ready to accept your redline and start DocuSign for MSA + Order Form. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/medixa/MSA-OrderForm-DL-8342

I'll await confirmation on the two outstanding evidence items so we can close the loop.

Thanks,
Anna Keller
